data.long_meaning: A beautiful Islamic name with deep spiritual significance. The name Dilawar carries the meaning “Noble and blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dilawar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
